modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: Every traveller can bring one (1) carry-on and one (1) personal item; the size limit depends on the aircraft.

carryon_bag_dimensions.value: Boeing routes: carry-on up to 38cm x 22cm x 54cm. ATR routes: combined dimensions cannot exceed 28cm x 22cm x 38cm.

personal_item.value: One (1) personal item. On Boeing routes it cannot exceed 33cm x 41cm x 15cm.

carryon_weight.value: No set weight: the carry-on must be light enough to store in the overhead bin unassisted.

piece_weight_economy.notes: Air North Economy Class checked baggage allowance.

piece_weight_business.value: 2 pieces up to 32 kg (70 lbs) each
piece_weight_business.notes: Air North Business Class checked baggage allowance.

piece_weight_first.value: 3 pieces up to 32 kg (70 lbs) each
piece_weight_first.notes: Air North First Class checked baggage allowance.

phone_home_market.value: 867.668.2228 ext. 1, option 1; toll-free in North America 1.800.661.0407 ext. 1, option 1

customer_service.value: For concerns, compensation or APPR inquiries: customerservice@flyairnorth.com
